name: Dolní Bousov (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a white band into a blue upper hoist part and a dark red lower fly part, with a yellow yoke-shaped charge with trefoil ends across the lower centre.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 11 May 2006 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
